description: AgentBench-DB style schema surgery: a denormalized one-table export must be normalized in place into customers/orders/order_items (case-insensitive email merge, quantities preserved, UNIQUE enforced by the schema) while the raw table stays as the immutable source the gate re-derives from.

criteria: The three target tables exist with the documented columns, emails are unique case-insensitively with a schema-level UNIQUE constraint, all 10 orders and every item row migrated with quantities preserved, and raw_orders still holds the original 10 rows.
